clue.text: A programme's introduction — one with stars on many buzzers!

indicators.note: a programme's introduction is its opening letter, so only the first letter is taken

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
Aries is a constellation and sign of the zodiac, a group of stars

explanation.surface: A TV show opens with a celebrity guest beside a crowd of buzzing gadgets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'buzzers' sounds like doorbells or game-show buttons, but here the buzzers are bees, and the definition names places full of them.
explanation.definitionFit: Bee colonies are kept in hives at such sites, so the term names a place housing many bees.

clue.text: "Carry on father" (French version) contains cut

indicators.note: contains says the French father holds the next piece inside him

parts.note: pere is the French word for father
to sever is to cut

explanation.surface: A title like a French remake of a Carry On comedy film, with a scene removed.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks around "Carry on father" make it look like a film title (the Carry On films are a long British comedy series), but "Carry on" is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep going in spite of difficulty is to persist, which is what carry on means here.

clue.text: Lively beer is right on time!

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer

explanation.surface: A beer is said to be lively and served at exactly the right moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lively and quick to respond is watchful and wide awake.

clue.text: Mysterious and strange Serbian cult

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of the two words are made odd, so rearranged

explanation.surface: A secretive Serbian sect is described as odd and enigmatic.
explanation.definitionFit: Something impossible to read or interpret is enigmatic, the sense of mysterious.

clue.text: Heartless opera with endless song all about a person in it

indicators.note: all about suggests the remaining letters are scattered and rearranged
the heart of the word opera is its middle letter, which is removed
endless says the final letter of the word song is dropped

explanation.surface: A gutted opera paired with an unfinished song, all centred on one performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartless' takes the E from the middle of OPERA, giving OPRA; 'endless' takes G off SONG, giving SON; 'all about' rearranges OPRASON. 'it' in the definition points back to the opera.
explanation.definitionFit: A high female voice part is sung by a singer who takes a role in an opera.

clue.text: After work I took drug to aid rest

indicators.note: After says the following pieces come behind the word for work

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work
to have eaten is to have taken food, so took gives ate

explanation.surface: Someone finishes a job and takes a sleeping pill to help them rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Narcotics derived from the poppy dull pain and bring sleep, so a sedating drug fits.

clue.text: Put gold round a blade

indicators.note: round says the word for gold is placed around the next letter

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: An instruction to gild a sword blade.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is gold in heraldry, the language of coats of arms.
explanation.definitionFit: The flat end of a rowing implement is its blade, and the whole can be called a blade by extension.

clue.text: Rests at home — then travels abroad

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in

indicators.note: abroad suggests the letters of travels wander and end up rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone takes breaks at home between trips overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Pauses or breaks between periods of activity are gaps of time, such as rests in music.

clue.text: Biting small cakes

parts.note: a biting taste is sharp or tart

explanation.surface: A description of sharp-tasting miniature cakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastry cases with sweet fillings are baked goods loosely called cakes.

clue.text: Start to talk then regret being honest

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, so only the first letter of talk is taken

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: Someone begins speaking and then regrets being candid.
explanation.definitionFit: Being honest means being faithful to the facts and sincere.

clue.text: Pressure to be worse off after shopping here?

indicators.note: be worse off suggests the letters are knocked out of shape, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Shoppers feel pressure that leaves them poorer after a trip to the big store.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be worse off' reads as a comment on the shopper's wallet but signals the rearrangement; the question mark marks the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: A very large retail outlet is a place where one does one's shopping.

clue.text: Improved a layer?

definitions.meaning: made or become finer than before
one who lays a bet, that is someone who wagers

explanation.definitionFit: Improved means finer than before; and someone who lays a wager is a punter, one who bets.

clue.text: Silly stab at trick that's hard to understand

indicators.note: silly suggests the word stab is being foolish and its letters fall out of order

parts.note: a ruse is a trick

explanation.surface: A foolish attempt at a trick that nobody can follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Obscure or recondite ideas are difficult to grasp.

clue.text: Snappy type shooting off about those over 30?

definitions.text: Snappy type shooting off about those over 30?

parts.words: Snappy type shooting off about those over 30?
parts.note: reads as an irritable person mouthing off about the middle-aged, but describes a roadside device that photographs drivers exceeding 30 mph

explanation.definitionFit: A roadside device snaps photographs of motorists going above the limit, such as 30 mph.

clue.text: Complaint from sun and theatre's touring without approval

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the rearranged letters go around the next piece
touring suggests the letters travel around and arrive rearranged

parts.note: the word theatre's supplies its letters, including the S
OK signals approval

explanation.surface: A theatre company tours unapproved and someone falls ill from too much sun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking, so the shuffled theatre (HEATSTRE, from 'touring') wraps around the approval; 'sun' looks like part of the wordplay but belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Overheating of the body after long exposure to strong sunshine is an illness, a medical complaint.

clue.text: Police staff left for turkey — and then it's a meal!

indicators.note: for signals that one letter is swapped for another, turkey standing in for left

parts.note: a luncheon is a midday meal
TR is the international vehicle code for Turkey

explanation.surface: Police cutlery is mentioned, then left out for a turkey dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turkey' looks like the bird but is the country, abbreviated TR as on car number plates.
explanation.definitionFit: A British police officer's club or baton is part of the force's kit, staff meaning stick.

clue.text: Left off slip in part of church

indicators.note: off says the letter for left is taken away from the word for slip

parts.note: a lapse is a slip or small error

explanation.surface: A slip of paper left behind in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: The semicircular recess at the east end of a church is an architectural part of it.

clue.text: 20 not starting to attack fall guy

indicators.note: not starting says the first letter of the word for running off is dropped

parts.note: 20 refers to the answer at 20 down, meaning to run off, which gives escape
to go at someone is to attack them

explanation.surface: Someone flees and then tries to blame an innocent victim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not starting' takes the first letter off ESCAPE, leaving SCAPE.
explanation.definitionFit: A person blamed for others' failings is a patsy, the same idea as a fall guy.

clue.text: Exercise and sport in the country

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise
RU is rugby union, a sport

explanation.surface: A remark on exercise and sport around the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: A South American nation on the Pacific coast is an example of a country.

clue.text: Label on an unknown game? This takes the biscuit!

parts.note: a brand is a label or trade name
in algebra Y is an unknown quantity
snap is a children's card game

explanation.surface: A brand name on a mystery game is so absurd it beats everything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'This takes the biscuit!' is an idiom for something outrageous, but literally a thin brandy-flavoured biscuit. SNAP is a card game where players call out matching cards.
explanation.definitionFit: A crisp rolled ginger wafer is a kind of biscuit, so it literally takes the name of one.

clue.text: Muscles ultimately required to stop prisoner's bolt

parts.note: abs are the abdominal muscles
con is short for convict, a prisoner

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word required

explanation.surface: Strong muscles are needed to stop a prisoner making a run for it.
explanation.definitionFit: To bolt is to run away suddenly, the same as fleeing from custody.

clue.text: … And some others touched nuts and bananas

definitions.meaning: carrying on from the biscuit in 19 across, more biscuits of a dry, savoury kind
touched is slang for slightly mad
nuts and bananas are both slang for crazy

explanation.definitionFit: Crackers are dry biscuits, carrying on from 19, and the word is also slang for mad, like touched, nuts or bananas.

clue.text: Dishy thing coming back in a tiara …

indicators.note: coming back says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something attractive returns in a jewelled headband.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dishy' seems to mean attractive, but the answer is literally a dish: a yoghurt side dish from Indian cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: A yoghurt and cucumber side dish served with curry is an item of food served as a dish.

clue.text: Learnt to play the horn

indicators.note: to play suggests the letters are moved about, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone learnt how to play the horn.
explanation.definitionFit: The branched bony growth on a deer's head is commonly called a horn.

clue.text: … And host runs away in skimpy underwear

indicators.note: away says the letter for runs is removed from the word for host

parts.note: a host is a great crowd or throng
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Following on, a party host runs off wearing very little.
explanation.walkthrough: 'host' looks like someone entertaining guests but means a multitude.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief undergarment with a narrow strip at the back is minimal underwear.

clue.text: In store men displayed fresh soup

indicators.note: displayed fresh suggests the letters are laid out anew in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Staff in a shop lay out freshly made soup.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick Italian vegetable broth with pasta is a well-known soup.

clue.text: Lacking hint of sun man won't do this!

definitions.text: Lacking hint of sun man won't do this!

indicators.note: lacking says the following letter is removed from the man's name

parts.note: Stan is a man's name

indicators.note: a hint of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Without sunshine a man won't get brown.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: STAN loses S, the first letter of 'sun', and without sun nobody browns.
explanation.definitionFit: Skin turns brown only with exposure to sunshine, so without it nobody browns.

clue.text: Leaders of orchestra ban obnoxious electric instrument

indicators.note: the leaders of the words are their opening letters, taken from the next four words

explanation.surface: The heads of an orchestra outlaw an unpleasant electric instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A double-reed woodwind is a musical instrument.

clue.text: Musical composition featuring gun in final part — this one

definitions.text: Musical composition featuring gun in final part — this one

indicators.note: featuring says the composition takes another letter into it

parts.note: a canon is a musical composition in which voices imitate each other

indicators.note: the final part of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A piece of music, like the 1812 Overture, that features artillery at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: Tchaikovsky's 1812 Overture famously has artillery guns fired in its final part.
explanation.definitionFit: Big guns fired in the closing section of Tchaikovsky's 1812 Overture are the artillery the clue describes.

clue.text: Game the windies are presumably good at?

definitions.text: Game the windies are presumably good at?

parts.words: Game the windies are presumably good at?
parts.note: the Windies are the West Indies cricket team; read as windy people, they would excel at a board game whose name also means currents of air

explanation.definitionFit: A board game played with counters, called checkers in the US, shares its name with cold air currents.
